items.t: Voted to table an amendment that would have set penalties for doctors providing gender-affirming care to minors in a bill prohibiting that care.
items.q: Among the Republicans to support tabling the amendment were Smith and Majority Leader David Hiott, both of whom Trump endorsed in the same Truth Social post.

record.t: Backed the nomination of James Smith to a state judgeship, which was rejected.
record.q: House Republicans attempted to confirm James Smith — South Carolina Democrats’ 2018 gubernatorial nominee and an “advocate” for Planned Parenthood — to a state judgeship. Despite receiving the backing of Speaker Smith, the nomination was rejected last month.
